resources.string: Key rejected. Reconnect this source under Connections in the Keeper's room with a valid key.
Out of credit with this source. Add credits in its billing settings, or switch to another source.
Rate limited. Wait a minute, or switch to another source.
Can't reach the service. Check your internet connection, then retry.
The service took too long to answer. Retry, or switch to another source.
The service is having trouble right now. Retry in a moment, or switch to another source.
No connected agent can do this work. Connect an AI source, or give the hive a repository its agent works in.
The plan was too long for the source's output limit. Try a shorter description, or a source with a larger limit.
The source did not accept this request. Retry, or switch to another source.
Something went wrong. Retry, or check your source under Connections in the Keeper's room.
This removes the saved key from this device. To use the source again you will need to paste a key again.
This removes the saved access token from this device. To use the service again you will need to paste a token again.
The language model is removed from this device.
The language model is removed from this device, and its saved key is deleted. To use it again you will need to install it and paste a key again.
The saved swarm data is unreadable. Recovering deletes every project, run and event stored on this device. This cannot be undone.
The run ends here and the escalated task is not retried.
The agent's plan is discarded and the task will not run as planned.
The model files are deleted from this device. You can download them again later.
The current pairing code stops working at once and your other device must be paired again with a new code.
Delete all projects and runs to recover
Options: repository, branch, continue a run
Enter a project name and an objective to start a run.
Enter a project name to start a run.
Enter an objective to start a run.
Enter this code in IDEaz on your other device: Settings → The Aive.
The relay is a server that passes encrypted messages between your devices. Leave it blank to use the default relay run by the developer.
Free gateways without a key may log your prompts and limit requests per IP address. Keep confidential data out of swarms that use it.
Prompts and repository text sent to a keyless source leave this device and may be logged. Free sources limit requests (Kilo 200 an hour, OVHcloud 2 a minute).
Approving lets the agent start making the changes in its plan. It may use your source quota and change the repository.
Approving lets this task go ahead. It may use your source quota or change files or services.
Approving lets this step of the sub-swarm continue. It may use your source quota or change files.
This step will run without waiting for your OK. Nothing it does will be held for you to approve.
This device stops sharing work with your other devices until you connect it again.
Anything using the current token stops working until you give it the new one.
This memory is deleted from this device. It cannot be undone.
Everything remembered on this device is replaced by what you pasted. It cannot be undone.
This schedule is deleted and will not start again.
The saved schedules that could not be read are deleted for good, and you start with an empty list.
Enter code %1$s on the source’s authorization page. The source controls login and any Google sign-in. Charges may apply.
Authorization is still pending. Complete it in your browser.
Authorize Aive in your browser, then copy the one-time code shown by OpenRouter. Your OpenRouter account may use Google sign-in. Model usage is billed to that account.

The memory kept before per-swarm banks is still on this device as a backup. It holds every swarm’s history in one place that Forget, retention and Forget everything do not reach. Records listed in the migration report as drawn from several swarms exist only there.
The old memory backup was deleted.
The old memory backup was not deleted.
Look through %1$s and fix the most important problem you find
Plan, build and review changes to %1$s

Fields for a goal, a repository, a swarm name or a message start with what you typed there before, or a starting suggestion made on this device. Up to 12 recent entries per kind are kept here, are never sent anywhere and are not in setup files. Fields for keys, tokens, pairing codes and the setup passphrase are never filled in or remembered.
